entries.title: Ask HN: I'm a Linux guy. Tell me about all those BSDs
entries.author: ghotli
entries.current_title: Ask HN: I'm a Linux guy. Tell me about all those BSDs
entries.excerpt: I use Linux and I have for nearly all of my teenage and adult life. I had a short foray into Solaris; ZFS was nice, and so were the raid tools. Otherwise I found it to be rather tedious. Tell me, why would I ever want to use one of those BSDs over Linux of some sort? What's the allure?
entries.guide_zh: 长期使用 Linux 的作者，希望了解各个 BSD 系统的特点和实际体验。

entries.title: Ask HN: All startup websites look the same
entries.author: phugoid
entries.current_title: Ask HN: All startup websites look the same
entries.excerpt: All recent startup websites look the same to me. I don't have the designer chops to explain it clearly, but the main style is: A whole lot of white, plus one dominant color (usually blue, green or dark grey) used for footer/header. Layout uses light-grey-to-white gradients to make gentle borders between columns and even tabs. Borders that don't use gradients are always 1px grey. Large rectangular rounded buttons in dominant color (or green, orange) with white lettering. Sans
entries.guide_zh: 白底、单一主色的创业网站越来越像，作者想讨论这种设计趋同。

entries.title: Ask HN: How to be successful online without SEO bullshittery?
entries.author: rkalla
entries.current_title: Ask HN: How to be successful online without SEO bullshittery?

Everything from fixing your MTU settings on your Q1000 modem to Java framework tips I find handy to years worth of game and movies reviews to hilarious cat pictures. entries.guide_zh: 长期认真写内容却难获关注，作者求助如何不靠 SEO 套路取得成功。

entries.title: Ask HN: Tips for Hackers having Kids?
entries.author: thegyppo
entries.current_title: Ask HN: Tips for Hackers having Kids?
entries.excerpt: In about 6 months I've got a lovely bundle of joy coming into the world, needless to say I'm extremely excited. Like many Hackers I work fairly long hours, especially weekends (sometimes when I get my best work done). I'd love to hear some tips from fellow hackers who have had kids & some tips on managing the transition to a more family focused life, without losing sight of goals & milestones that you have for your startup.
entries.guide_zh: 孩子即将出生，习惯长时间工作的黑客该如何准备成为父母？
